hash.description: Fingerprint of the workflow definition as resolved by the spindle. Absent when derived is false.

derived.description: Whether the workflow definition is derived from this repository at all. When false, no commit-to-commit comparison is meaningful (e.g. definitions managed externally), and callers should not surface change warnings.

workflows.description: Names or paths of the effective workflow files that produced the hash.

sha.description: Commit SHA to resolve the workflow definition at

repo.description: Target repository DID the workflow definition belongs to.

sourceRepo.description: Repository DID to resolve workflow definitions from, if different from the target repo

main.description: Resolve the workflow definition a pipeline would use at a given commit and return a fingerprint of it.
